components.name: View
components.notes: Yoga layout, background, corner radius and opacity. Border, clipping and transform limits are listed below. With the default-OFF accessibility bridge enabled, Pi400 evidence covers native generic View semantic queries and actual React registered activate delivery with semantic-label updates. Qt action-list/custom-label parity, RN disabled semantic state, values and reader output remain unqualified. Pi 400 gallery capture (1280x800 window, build feat/expo-image-painted-view merged with main #157, exact revision unrecorded): the View + Text card shows three coloured Views laid out by Yoga. Render only; no interaction.

components.name: Text
components.notes: Styled, wrapped text and numberOfLines ellipsis. Inline attachments have zero size. The same gallery capture shows styled Text in many cards. Wrapping and numberOfLines are not shown on the device.

components.name: Image
components.notes: Data URIs, Metro assets and HTTP(S) loading; load events and a header-aware bounded memory cache. See [image loading](image-loader.md). Pi 400: the gallery Image card renders a bundled PNG ("PNG decoded by the image backend"; tile-layout window-1280x800.png, build revision unrecorded). The "Image from a URL" card logged `Image.getSize` 640x427 over HTTPS in run 2 (commit 240dc08), with an unexplained 154149 ms load time. Image events, resizeMode and the memory cache were not exercised on the device.

components.name: ScrollView
components.notes: Qt Flickable scrolling, lifecycle events and scrollTo/scrollToEnd. zoomScale is reported in metrics; visible content scale stays 1. Pi 400, run 2 (commit 240dc08): the Components tab is a ScrollView. gallery-first-screen.png shows it at offset 0 and modal-after-escape.png shows it scrolled down to the Switch and Modal cards after injected `wheel` events (run.txt). run.txt does not map each wheel command to a screenshot. Drag scrolling, scrollTo and lifecycle events were not exercised.

components.name: TextInput
components.notes: Controlled/default text, focus/blur, edit/selection/key/submit events and basic styling. Pi400 proof uses synthetic Qt input through actual React with the default-OFF TextInput contract enabled: edit counts, UTF-16 selection and Tab/Backtab focus traversal. Physical HID, software keyboard, IME provider and assistive technology remain unqualified.

components.name: Pressable
components.notes: Host pointer press delivers onPress. Pi 400 synthetic Qt input exercises real React Pressable/responder dispatch and remount recovery; physical HID, RNGH and Worklets remain unverified.

components.name: FlatList
components.notes: Scroll-following virtualization, off-window cell release, onLayout and onContentSizeChange are host-tested. Pi 400: the gallery Advanced tab is a FlatList of cards. In run 2 (commit 240dc08) injected `wheel` events moved it from the Image and Xml cards to the Filters and Video cards (svg-filters.png, svg-video-card-qtvideo-absent.png; the command-to-screenshot mapping is inferred from run.txt). drawer-route-2026-11-13/documents.png shows the Documents tab (1,000 rows) rendering rows 001 to 010 behind an open drawer. Scrolling the Documents list, onEndReached, recycling and keyboard scrolling were not exercised.

components.name: VirtualizedList
components.notes: Covered transitively by the FlatList virtualization test. Importable from react-native through the QNX public entry; the render test mounts it there. Pi 400: 300 rows with getItemLayout, windowSize 5. Initial render stopped at index 25; scrollToIndex(150) and wheel scrolling moved the render window (up to 150, 175, 200), onScroll offsets and onViewableItemsChanged windows (12 to 13 rows) were logged. onEndReached was not reached. Limit: no touch or kinetic flick tested, wheel and Screen-injected drag only. Evidence: docs/evidence/pi400-v1-gates-2026-11-24 (Pi 400, 2026-11-24, org.rnqnx.playground with apps/rn-playground/component-device-probe.js, input from rnqnx-inject through QNX Screen).

components.name: KeyboardAvoidingView
components.notes: Renders children as a View and forwards the other View props; behavior, keyboardVerticalOffset, enabled and contentContainerStyle are ignored because no Keyboard module is wired. The override sits at the upstream path, so the Metro resolver selects it. Pi 400: renders its children and fires onLayout; behavior, keyboardVerticalOffset and enabled are accepted. Limit: no soft keyboard exists on this board, so avoidance cannot occur. Evidence: docs/evidence/pi400-v1-gates-2026-11-24 (Pi 400, 2026-11-24, org.rnqnx.playground with apps/rn-playground/component-device-probe.js, input from rnqnx-inject through QNX Screen).

components.name: QtVideo
components.notes: Opt-in (RNQNX_ENABLE_QT_VIDEO, needs the Qt Multimedia add-on). Qt Multimedia FFmpeg backend, software decode, frames in the Qt Quick scene graph. Props: source, paused, muted, volume, rate, repeat, resizeMode, poster, controls, fullscreen; events: onLoad, onProgress, onEnd, onError, onBuffer, onSeek, onFullscreen; ref: seek, play, pause. Pi 400 (2026-11-13, branch feat/qt-video, no commit SHA in the receipt): 480x270 H.264/AAC clip played, seek, pause, play, end and bad-URL error reached JavaScript; after FFmpeg was rebuilt with OpenSSL 3, an https clip (960x540, 5.06 s) played 143 frames in 5.0 s. No hardware decode. A host test (tests/native/qt-video) and JS tests (tests/js/qt-video.test.mjs) exist; the host-renderer workflow sets RNQNX_ENABLE_QT_VIDEO on its ON leg. Control-bar taps and fullscreen not exercised. The 2026-11-19 Pi 400 builds had QtVideo OFF (the Video and Audio cards read "QtVideo is not in this build"), so they say nothing about it. The react-native-video 7 beta cannot load on the pinned Nitro v1; a JavaScript API subset exists but has not run.

components.name: QtAudio
components.notes: No component named QtAudio exists in the code; this row records audio output through QtVideo. QtVideo plays audio files through Qt AudioOutput and the QNX io-snd backend. The Pi 400 image has only the 3.5 mm jack (bcm2711_pwm); io-snd had to be started as root and was not running by default. The audio device opened and a 3 s WAV played to its end; audibility not confirmed by ear. No HDMI audio driver on this image. react-native-audio-api is not supported (no QNX player or JSI installer). Output device is chosen in QnxVideo.qml (audioDevice prop; empty picks a USB device, else the named card); onLoad reports the chosen device. The image has no HDMI audio driver.
